instructions: Fill in an entry as you finish its task. result: fixed, not_reproducible, no_change_needed, blocked. failedBefore: true when a test failed on the unchanged code for this issue's reason, false when none could be made to fail. test: the test's file and name. proof: the failing output, or why no test could show the defect. checkedEndToEnd: true when the fix was also checked by a browser or integration test or a run of the app, false when only by unit tests. foundWhileFixing: one entry for each defect you found while fixing that no issue names, with title, severity, where (file and symbol), result, failedBefore, test and proof as above.
